themes.mechanism: Each color is a custom property on :root; under @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) the same properties take the -dark values. Components reference the light token names and switch with them. There is no theme toggle.
themes.tonalRampNote: The tonalRamp arrays are synthesized for the panel (eight OKLCH lightness steps at each token's own chroma and hue). The system itself has no tonal scale and uses only its seven tokens per theme.

display.purpose: The surface's one headline (.voice-display), max 16ch. From 1024px its lines are composed as blocks; below, it wraps freely.

headline.purpose: Section headlines, whole sentences of 14 to 16ch. Set beside a clause: clamp(2.25rem, 4.4vw, 3.75rem).

headline-lead.purpose: The headline on a highlighter field. The closing statement uses clamp(2.5rem, 5vw, 4.5rem).

figure-lead.purpose: The reader's key euro figure (.voice-figure). The payout on the field runs to clamp(3rem, 6vw, 5.25rem). Shrinks in proportion beyond its designed length (--fit).

figure.purpose: Secondary figures, yearly totals and ruler readouts; 2rem for the margin's second figure from 1024px, 1.375rem for readouts below 640px.

clause-lead.purpose: The clause that holds the blanks (.voice-clause, optical sizing auto); 1.1875rem on a 2rem line below 1024px.

clause.purpose: Every other clause, 52 to 62ch, on 0.85 of the clause line; 1.125rem below 1024px. Its § head runs in at 600.

lede.purpose: The plain sentence under a headline, in ink-soft, 40 to 48ch; 1.0625rem below 1024px.

gloss.purpose: The head of VestWise's margin note; the sentence after it is 400 in ink-soft.

label.purpose: Figure, annex, year and signature labels; 1rem for ruler and payout labels; 500 for letterhead links and the margin figure's label.

button-lg.purpose: Label of the 3.5rem button on signature lines.

blank.purpose: The agreement's fill-in fields, sized from their clause (0.9em).

caption.purpose: Signature captions, yearly details and footer links.

micro.purpose: Exhibit labels and ruler ticks; the Today tag and the exhibit's marker titles at 700.

wordmark.purpose: VestWise after a 0.42em by 0.95em mark bar, 0.45em apart; 1.3125rem in the letterhead, 1.0625rem in the running head, 1.125rem in the footer.

shadows.name: blank-rule
shadows.purpose: Not elevation: a blank's underline, drawn inside its box so it can thicken without moving the text. The only box-shadow in the system.

shadows.name: blank-rule-hover
shadows.purpose: A blank's underline on fine-pointer hover.

shadows.name: blank-rule-focus
shadows.purpose: A focused blank's underline, over its mark field.

shadows.name: blank-rule-invalid
shadows.purpose: An invalid blank's underline, with a 2px line-through on the text.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: --ease-out: every state change, entrance and figure roll.

motion.name: ease-in-out
motion.purpose: --ease-in-out: drawing, for the letterhead rule and the exhibit's vested wipe.

motion.name: ease-marker
motion.purpose: --ease-marker: the highlighter's load sweep only.

motion.name: duration-press
motion.purpose: Button press to scale(0.97); a text link's underline thickening to 2px.

motion.name: duration-state
motion.purpose: Blank background, underline and color; tickbox fill; ruler thumb widening to scaleX(1.6).

motion.name: duration-button
motion.purpose: Button colors and the arrow's 3px nudge.

motion.name: mark-sweep-load
motion.purpose: Highlighter copy clip-path from inset(0 100% 0 0) to inset(0 0 0 0) on load (headline word at 850ms, key figure at 1000ms).

motion.name: mark-sweep-scroll
motion.value: linear; animation-timeline: view(); animation-range: entry 70% cover 42%
motion.purpose: The same sweep, linked to reading the marked words.

motion.name: read-focus
motion.value: linear; animation-timeline: view(); animation-range: cover 5% cover 95%
motion.purpose: A clause's color from ink-muted to ink (35% to 65%) and back as it crosses the viewport.

motion.name: redline-strike
motion.value: linear; animation-timeline: view(); animation-range: entry 60% cover 40%
motion.purpose: The redline bar from scaleX(0) to scaleX(1), from the left.

motion.name: roll-edit
motion.value: 460ms var(--ease-out), 18ms cascade from the units up
motion.purpose: Every computed figure when its value changes; interruptible while typing.

motion.name: roll-intro
motion.value: 1200ms var(--ease-out), 70ms stagger left to right, from 900ms
motion.purpose: The key figure rolling up from zeros on load.

motion.name: rule-draw
motion.purpose: The letterhead rule drawing from the left (scaleX) on load.

motion.name: line-up
motion.purpose: From 1024px, each display line rises from translateY(104%) inside its own clip.

motion.name: fade-up
motion.purpose: From opacity 0.6 and 0.75rem below: lede, clause, margin and signature line at 350ms to 560ms; below 1024px the whole display at 150ms.

motion.name: appear
motion.purpose: Letterhead wordmark and links, opacity from 0, on load.

motion.name: running-head
motion.purpose: translateY(-100%) to 0 once the opening part has scrolled away; no transition under reduced motion.

motion.name: exhibit-draw
motion.value: past 1100ms var(--ease-in-out); future 700ms after 900ms; flag 400ms fade and 500ms move after 1000ms
motion.purpose: Once, when 40% of the exhibit is in view; drawn from the start under reduced motion.

motion.name: gate-reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Wraps every entrance, sweep, roll, draw and smooth scroll; the resting CSS is the finished state.

motion.name: gate-scroll-timeline
motion.purpose: Wraps the scroll-linked sweep, strike and reading focus.

motion.name: gate-hover
motion.purpose: Wraps hover effects.

breakpoints.name: sm
breakpoints.purpose: Gutters to 2rem, three yearly columns, larger ruler readouts, the running head's sentence.

breakpoints.name: md
breakpoints.purpose: Letterhead links, two signature columns, the footer row.

breakpoints.name: lg
breakpoints.purpose: 12-column grid, --line to 2.5rem, gutters to 3rem, composed display lines.

narrative.overview:
The page is one document: a sample VSOP grant agreement, set clause by clause in a book serif, that VestWise marks up in its own voice. The reader fills in its blanks; VestWise answers in the margin, in euros; a highlighter picks out the words that matter, a redline strikes a share count into its euro value, and the reader's signature line carries the action. Two typefaces play the two parties. Source Serif 4 is the agreement. Archivo, heavy and widened, is VestWise. Whatever the reader can change is a blank inside a sentence, and whatever VestWise computes from it is a figure in VestWise's voice; the key figures roll to their new values as the terms change.

The materials are paper, ink and one highlighter. The sheet is a near-neutral copy-paper white by day and a graphite sheet at night; the ink is a cool near-black with two receding greys; the highlighter is a fluorescent yellow that only ever appears as a flat, full-strength field. There are seven tokens per theme and nothing between them. Structure comes from 1px ink rules and whitespace measured on one vertical unit, the clause line. There are no cards, no shadows, no gradients and no rounded corners: a rule opens each part, a vertical rule divides the terms from VestWise's answer, and the highlighter, not elevation, says where to look.

Motion follows reading. A surface may open with one authored sequence (the letterhead rule draws, the headline unmasks, the highlighter sweeps, the key figure rolls up from zero); after that, motion is tied to reading: the clause in view deepens to full ink, phrases are highlighted as they are read, the annex draws itself once, and the closing redline strikes through. Every animated element rests in its finished state, so reduced motion, or a browser without scroll timelines, gets the finished page.
keyCharacteristics: One document: clauses, blanks, margin glosses, an annex, a redline and signatures.
Two voices: Source Serif 4 for the agreement, Archivo at 800 weight and 112% width for VestWise.
Paper, ink and one highlighter: seven OKLCH tokens per theme, swapped wholesale by prefers-color-scheme.
1px ink rules on a single vertical unit, the clause line (2rem, 2.5rem from 1024px); every corner square.
Computed figures only: tabular, formatted in the reader's locale, the key ones rolling digit by digit.
Flat: no cards, shadows, blur or gradients.
Motion rests in its final state and runs only under prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference.

rules.name: The One Highlighter Rule
rules.body: mark is the only chroma in the system, and at rest it is always a flat, full-strength field with mark-ink on it: never tinted, translucent, outlined, rounded or graded, never a glow or an underline stroke. When a mark moves, a clip-path wipe moves its edge; its strength never animates.

rules.name: The Mark-Ink Rule
rules.body: Whatever sits on yellow is mark-ink: words, figures, rules, ticks, icons, focus rings and fine print. A highlighter field has no greys. Inverting it (a mark-ink block with mark figures) is the only way to emphasise something already on the field.

rules.name: The Never Alone Rule
rules.body: On the day sheet the yellow is a change of hue, not of value (about 1.15:1 against paper), so it never carries meaning by itself: every mark has mark-ink words, a label or an icon on or beside it.

rules.name: The Night Sheet Rule
rules.body: At night the yellow is about 14:1 against the sheet, so a highlighter field is held to the sheet's measure (the 1320px frame, inside the gutters) instead of bleeding to the viewport edge.

rules.name: The Seven Tokens Rule
rules.body: There is no tonal scale. New work uses the seven tokens of the theme; the only derived color in the system is the exhibit's 7% ink wash for shares still to vest.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: The agreement speaks only in Source Serif 4: clauses, § heads, sub-clauses, the struck share count, the other party's signature placeholder. It capitalises its defined terms (Virtual Shares, Strike Price, Cliff) and writes amounts as "EUR 4.00". VestWise speaks only in Archivo: headlines, figures, glosses, labels and controls, in plain lowercase terms and with the € sign. A blank is VestWise's voice set into the agreement's sentence.

rules.name: The Width Ladder Rule
rules.body: Archivo carries hierarchy on its width axis as well as its weight: 100% for running text, 106% for blanks, 108% for buttons and gloss heads, 112% for display, figures and the wordmark. Nothing is set narrower than 100% or wider than 112%, and nothing tracks tighter than -0.03em.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every number a reader compares or watches change is set in tabular lining figures: figures, blanks, ledger values, the exhibit's axis labels, ruler ticks and the running head's figure.

rules.name: The One Word Rule
rules.body: A headline highlights at most one word: the word the sentence turns on, at its end, with the full stop inside the mark ("VSOP.", "euros."). Most headlines carry none. In running text a mark may cover a short phrase ("where you are today").

rules.name: The Run-in Rule
rules.body: § numbers are the agreement's own structure. They run in at the start of their clause in serif 600 ("§ 2 Vesting."), sub-clauses as "4.1"; a § number is never a label on its own line above a headline.

rules.name: The Clause Line Rule
rules.body: Distances between blocks and parts are multiples of --line (0.85, 1, 1.25, 1.5, 2, 2.5 or 3); the 0.25rem step is only for distances inside a block.

rules.name: The Terms Left Rule
rules.body: In any split the terms or the inputs sit left and VestWise's answer sits right of a 1px rule.

rules.name: The Rule, Not Shadow Rule
rules.body: Whatever must separate or float gets a 1px ink rule (2px above a total) and the sheet behind it; never a shadow, a blur or a second surface color.

dos: Do take every color from the seven theme tokens and let prefers-color-scheme swap the set; anything on yellow is mark-ink.
Do keep the highlighter a flat, full-strength field tight to its words (0.07em each side, overhanging left only), and move it only with a clip-path wipe.
Do highlight at most one word per headline: the word the sentence turns on, with its full stop.
Do set the agreement in Source Serif 4 and everything VestWise says, computes or offers in Archivo, and put inputs into sentences as blanks.
Do separate with 1px ink rules (2px above a total) and measure the space between blocks in clause lines (2rem; 2.5rem from 1024px).
Do set numbers in tabular lining figures and the reader's locale, and roll the key figures digit by digit when they change (460ms, 18ms cascade).

Do write the finished state as the resting CSS, and add motion only inside prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference, scroll-linked motion only inside @supports (animation-timeline: view()), and hover only for (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine).
Do hold a highlighter field to the sheet's 1320px measure at night.

Do theme the browser's own surfaces: selection in mark (inverted on a highlighter field), the caret and the 2px focus ring in ink (mark-ink on a highlighter field), the scrollbar in ink-muted on paper, and link underlines at a 0.22em offset.
donts: Don't use cards, shadows, blur, glass or gradients; the running head floats on paper above a rule, and nothing else floats.
Don't tint, fade, outline or round the highlighter, draw it as a partial-height marker stroke, or set grey text on it.
Don't add a second accent or a tint of ink or mark; the exhibit's 7% ink wash is the only derived color.
Don't use an em dash or an en dash in visible copy; use a colon, a comma, a full stop or parentheses, and a true minus sign (−) for a subtraction.
Don't set a § number, or any short label, on its own line above a headline; § heads run in at the start of their clause.
Don't set Archivo narrower than 100% or wider than 112%, or track it tighter than -0.03em.
Don't set anything in the figure voice that the page did not compute from its own terms: no stat rows, counts or decorative numbers.
Don't give each part its own entrance; after the one load sequence, motion belongs to reading.
Don't stand Unicode glyphs or emoji in for icons; icons are Lucide line icons at stroke 2 to 3, sized to the text (§, × and − are typography, not icons).
extending: Decide which part of the agreement it is. New content enters as a part the document already has: a clause with its margin annotation, sub-clauses with glosses, an annex with an exhibit and a yearly ledger, a highlighter field for a calculation, a signature block for the action. Use that part's components as written above; new clauses continue the § numbering.
Use the same sheet. The 1320px frame and gutters, the letterhead and its rule, the clause line, and from 1024px the 12-column grid with the terms left of the rule and VestWise's answer right of it.

Spend the yellow sparingly. At most one headline word, the reader's key figure, the current moment ("Today", "this year"), focus and selection, and a highlighter field only for a page's interactive answer; the landing has one.
Keep motion inside the grammar. A load sequence only where a surface opens, reading devices after it, and nothing outside the gates.

Rasters are pages of the document. The 1200 by 630 share image is set like a first viewport: the day sheet, the letterhead row and rule (wordmark left, domain right), the headline with its one highlighted word, a sample clause with blanks, and the margin figure on the highlighter, labelled as sample.
New components inherit the materials. Square corners, 1px rules, mark-ink on mark, tabular figures, 140ms to 160ms --ease-out state changes and the global focus ring.
